name: Meeting Schedule Merge to PDF
prompt:
In the patent_event_schedules directory on the desktop there are four .ics meeting schedule files: event_internal_review.ics (internal sunscreen formula avoidance design workshop), event_el_packaging.ics (Estée Lauder pump head design patent briefing), event_loreal_q3.ics (L'Oréal anti-aging new ingredient launch), and event_botanical_extracts.ics (plant extract database retrieval training).

Please read and parse all these .ics files, extract the detailed information of each schedule event such as the subject (SUMMARY), start time (DTSTART), location (LOCATION), and description (DESCRIPTION), and then merge them into one PDF document in ascending order of meeting start time. In terms of layout, each meeting event must occupy a full page by itself; multiple meetings must not be crowded onto the same page, and content must not be truncated by page breaks. In addition, the generated PDF must automatically have global outline bookmarks, with the bookmark names directly using the subject of each meeting.

Save the final output file as patent_event_schedules/Schedule_Summary.pdf on the desktop.
